title: Les engagements, les souhaits et les contraintes au futur
summary: Coordinate who will come, what will be possible and what people will have to do.
objectives: Conjugate venir, tenir, vouloir, pouvoir and devoir in the future.
Apply venir/tenir stems to common derivatives.

sources.label: University of Texas: irregular future stems

sections.title: Venir and tenir share a shape
paragraphs: Venir (to come) uses viendr-; tenir (to hold or keep) uses tiendr-. Add -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont. The inserted d belongs to the future stem, not the present forms.

The prefixes stay on derivatives: revenir (come back) gives reviendr-, devenir (become) deviendr-, prévenir (warn) préviendr-; obtenir (obtain) gives obtiendr-, retenir (retain or remember) retiendr-, maintenir (maintain) maintiendr- and soutenir (support) soutiendr-. Attach all six endings exactly as in the models. For example: je reviendrai, tu reviendras, il/elle/on reviendra, nous reviendrons, vous reviendrez, ils/elles reviendront.
points: Vocabulary: une promesse (feminine), a promise; un délai (masculine), a time limit or delay.

examples.french:
je **viendrai**
tu **viendras**
il/elle/on **viendra**
nous **viendrons**
vous **viendrez**
ils/elles **viendront**
examples.english:
I will come
you will come (singular)
he/she/one will come
we will come
you will come (plural or polite)
they will come
examples.note: Venir uses viendr- in all persons.

examples.french:
je **tiendrai**
tu **tiendras**
il/elle/on **tiendra**
nous **tiendrons**
vous **tiendrez**
ils/elles **tiendront**
examples.english:
I will hold/keep
you will hold/keep (singular)
he/she/one will hold/keep
we will hold/keep
you will hold/keep (plural or polite)
they will hold/keep

examples.note: Tenir une promesse is a natural use of tenir.

examples.french: Vous **obtiendrez** une réponse sous huit jours.
examples.english: You will receive an answer within eight days.

mistakes.why: Venir uses viendr-, not the whole infinitive.

sections.title: Want to, be able to, have to
paragraphs: Vouloir, pouvoir and devoir are often followed directly by an infinitive: no à or de is added. Their future stems are voudr-, pourr- and devr-. Vouloir expresses a wish or willingness; pouvoir expresses possibility or ability; devoir usually expresses an obligation in the situations here.

Je voudrai means I will want; it is not the usual polite request je voudrais, I would like. Likewise je pourrai is future ability, while je pourrais is conditional possibility. Devoir can also convey an expectation or inference, so context matters; the timetable examples here concern requirements.
points: Pouvoir has two r letters in its future stem; devoir has one.
A future form describes the anticipated situation, not necessarily the speaker's present preference.

examples.french:
je **voudrai**
tu **voudras**
il/elle/on **voudra**
nous **voudrons**
vous **voudrez**
ils/elles **voudront**
examples.english:
I will want
you will want (singular)
he/she/one will want
we will want
you will want (plural or polite)
they will want
examples.note: Future wanting is distinct from a polite conditional.

examples.french:
je **pourrai**
tu **pourras**
il/elle/on **pourra**
nous **pourrons**
vous **pourrez**
ils/elles **pourront**
examples.english:
I will be able to
you will be able to (singular)
he/she/one will be able to
we will be able to
you will be able to (plural or polite)
they will be able to
examples.note: The double r is visible throughout.

examples.french:
je **devrai**
tu **devras**
il/elle/on **devra**
nous **devrons**
vous **devrez**
ils/elles **devront**
examples.english:
I will have to
you will have to (singular)
he/she/one will have to
we will have to
you will have to (plural or polite)
they will have to
examples.note: These translations fit an obligation context.

examples.french: Après le voyage, tu **voudras** sûrement te reposer.
examples.english: After the journey, you will probably want to rest.
examples.note: A prediction about a future wish.

examples.french: Nous **pourrons** entrer, mais nous **devrons** montrer nos billets.
examples.english: We will be able to enter, but we will have to show our tickets.

mistakes.why: Pouvoir is followed directly by an infinitive.

practice.prompt: Supply venir in the future: Tu ___ avec nous.
Supply tenir in the future: Nous ___ le stand.
Supply pouvoir in the future: Vous ___ réserver en ligne.
Choose the verb that expresses a future requirement, not a wish: Vous ___ présenter une pièce d'identité.
practice.explanation: Devoir states the requirement in this context.

practice.prompt: Supply devenir in the future: Cette salle ___ un atelier.
practice.explanation: Devenir retains venir's viendr- pattern after de-.

practice.prompt: Supply maintenir in the future: Nous ___ le prix actuel.
Supply vouloir in the future: Les enfants ___ essayer le jeu.
practice.explanation: A plural subject uses voudr- plus -ont.

practice.prompt: Supply devoir in the future: Je ___ partir à midi.
practice.explanation: Devr- plus -ai gives a future obligation.

practice.prompt: Supply pouvoir in the future: On ___ modifier la date.
Supply prévenir in the future: Je vous ___ en cas de retard.
practice.explanation: Prévenir gives préviendr-, with the accent retained.

practice.prompt: Supply obtenir in the future: Elles ___ une réduction.
Supply vouloir in the future, not the conditional: Je ___ peut-être changer de poste plus tard.
practice.explanation: Je future ends in -ai; voudrais would be conditional.

practice.prompt: Supply revenir in the future: Vous ___ la semaine prochaine.
Supply devoir in the future: Nous ___ recommencer.
Supply pouvoir in the future: Elles ___ vous accompagner.
Supply soutenir in the future: Tu ___ notre proposition.
practice.explanation: Soutenir follows tenir with sou- retained.

practice.prompt: Supply retenir in the future: Vous ___ surtout les points essentiels.
practice.explanation: Retenir uses retiendr-, following tenir rather than its full infinitive.

production_task.prompt: Arrange a group visit. Explain who will come, one promise, one possible activity and one compulsory step. Use venir/tenir or a derivative, pouvoir and devoir.
production_task.model_answer: Nous viendrons samedi et nous tiendrons notre promesse d'aider. Vous pourrez visiter l'atelier après le déjeuner. Les visiteurs devront porter un badge. Je vous préviendrai si l'horaire change.
production_task.translation: We will come on Saturday and keep our promise to help. You will be able to visit the workshop after lunch. Visitors will have to wear a badge. I will let you know if the schedule changes.
rubric: Distinguish a promise, possibility and requirement.
Use direct infinitives after pouvoir and devoir.
Keep each derivative's prefix and irregular stem.
